recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-44500 wording in active core source and no further core change is needed for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-44500 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested removing markdown-specific wording from Requirements.statement, changing the definition to "A detailed statement of a conformance requirement." and the short display to "Conformance requirement statement."
initial_application: No FHIR-44500-tagged git commit was found. Commit 7da8914d3dc197ecc758ea1ed409e6b9f9c1dc85, titled FHIR-49734, changed Requirements.statement from the old markdown wording to "Conformance requirement statement" and "The actual statement of conformance requirement.", which removed the markdown mistake but left the approved FHIR-44500 definition incomplete.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists requirements=Requirements and marks Requirements normative, so source/requirements/structuredefinition-Requirements.xml and the resource diagram are in current build scope. Requirements.statement.requirement remains the markdown child carrying the actual requirement text, confirming the parent backbone should not be described as markdown. FHIR-49734 was checked because its tagged commit touched the seed source, but that issue concerns ElementDefinition.requirements and was handled as a separate audit.
reconciliation: Changed source/requirements/structuredefinition-Requirements.xml so Requirements.statement.definition is "A detailed statement of a conformance requirement." and changed the matching source/requirements/requirements.svg title tooltip to the same wording without terminal punctuation. The existing short value "Conformance requirement statement" was left unchanged because it matches the approved short substantively and follows local short-display punctuation conventions.
source_changes: source/requirements/structuredefinition-Requirements.xml: updated Requirements.statement definition to the approved conformance requirement wording.
source/requirements/requirements.svg: updated the Requirements.statement diagram title tooltip to match the corrected definition.

related_jiras.note: A later commit with this key modified Requirements.statement during the same evidence trail, but the Jira request itself concerns ElementDefinition.requirements and was audited separately.
